text:
Two slices of toast (one with jam) and two small egg-bake or sweet potato-like muffins sit on a plate of roughly 22-24 cm.

Toast slices: each is about 10x10 cm, so about 30 g per slice, or 60 g total. That is about 160 kcal. The jam adds roughly 15 g and 40 kcal.

The two orange round items are about 6 cm across and 3 cm tall. They look like egg soufflé or egg bites. At about 45 g each, they come to 90 g and about 140 kcal.

Total mass is about 60 + 15 + 90 = 165 g. Total energy is about 160 + 40 + 140 = 340 kcal.

{"kcal": 340, "mass_g": 165}
